record.question: Fill in the blanks: (a) Escape from confinement or custody negligently suffered by public servant is punishable under section _____________ of IPC. (b) Voluntarily causing hurt to extort confession, or to compel restoration of property shall be punished with _____________ under section 330 of IPC. (c) A, a police officer, tortures B to induce him to point out where certain stolen property is deposited. A is guilty of an offence under _____________ section. (d) Whoever voluntarily causing grievous hurt to extort confession, or to compel restoration of property shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine under section _____________ of IPC. (e) A causes Z to go within a walled space, and locks Z in. A is thus prevented from proceeding in any direction beyond the circumscribing line of wall. A _____________ Z.
